script: Ariana Grande's songs aren't just catchy tunes; they're her raw, unedited diary entries, revealing shocking personal truths. Many artists write from experience, but Ariana takes it to another level. She meticulously crafts lyrics directly from her deepest heartbreaks, healing journeys, and even public controversies. Think about "thank u, next"—every name and sentiment was a real-time reflection of her life unfolding. Or how "eternal sunshine" delves into profound grief and acceptance. She doesn't just sing about emotions; she *lives* them through her music, offering a transparent glimpse into her world. This isn't just pop; it's a public journal, making her songs her raw, unedited diary entries, revealing shocking personal truths.
